jobs.title: Salesforce Operations & Data Quality Specialist
jobs.description: Cprime is an AI-first, human-centered partner, combining strategic consulting with industry-leading platforms to drive innovation, enhance efficiency, and shift enterprise toward AI native thinking. Founded in 2003 and headquartered in the US, our clients span the globe and include more than 300 of the Fortune 500 companies. We bring deep expertise across Atlassian, IBM Apptio, ServiceNow, cloud, data, and enterprise agility to enable intelligent enterprises where people and AI orchestrate as one. \n Summary We are seeking a highly detail-oriented Salesforce Operations & Data Quality Specialist to support the integrity, accuracy, and scalability of our licensing and renewal operations. This role will serve as the operational owner for data quality monitoring, exception management, account maintenance, and customer record cleanup across Salesforce and Atlassian PPC systems. What you will do: Monitor Salesforce error queues and exception-tracking objects. Review and triage data-related issues impacting renewals and licensing processes. Perform manual data corrections to ensure record accuracy and completeness. Identify and remediate duplicate, missing, incomplete, and mismatched renewal records. Maintain account alias mappings for customer-name variations and account matching. Manage customer and billing-profile cleanup efforts across all Cprime accounts within Atlassian PPC. Escalate confirmed system defects and complex issues to the Licensing Technical team with clear documentation. Report on recurring issues, data cleanup progress, trends, and operational metrics. Recommend process improvements that increase data accuracy and reduce manual effort. Required Skills & Qualifications: 1+ years of experience in Salesforce Operations, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data Quality, Business Operations, or a related field. Experience working with Salesforce data management, reporting, and record maintenance. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Track record of building executive-level relationships and influencing multiple stakeholders across business and technology organizations Excellent presentation, communication, and executive facilitation skills. Preferred Skills (Good to Have): Experience supporting SaaS, licensing, subscription, or renewal operations. Familiarity with Atlassian products and licensing environments. Salesforce Administrator certification or equivalent experience. \n What We Believe In At Cprime we believe in facilitating social justice action internally, in industry, and within our communities. We believe part of our mission is to expand the minds, hearts, and opportunities of our Cprime teammates and within the broader community to include those who have been historically marginalized. Equal Employment Opportunity Statement Cprime is an equal-opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: GTM AI Operations - India
jobs.description: This opportunity requires that you work a specific shift as this is a region specific role. About JumpCloud® JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times. JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT. \n What You'll Be Doing: Reporting to the Sr. Director of Marketing Operations, this role will focus on designing, building, and operationalizing agentic outbound systems that improve pipeline generation efficiency and seller productivity. Core Objectives: Build Agentic Outbound Systems Design and deploy AI outbound workflows that automate account sourcing, contact acquisition, research, prioritization, personalization, sequencing, and engagement orchestration. Operationalize AI at Scale Move beyond isolated AI experiments by building repeatable, production-ready workflows that integrate across Salesforce, Marketo, Clay, sequencing platforms, enrichment providers, and engagement tools. Improve Outbound Efficiency Reduce manual BDR work through automation while increasing outbound quality, targeting precision, personalization, and activity scalability. Accelerate Pipeline Generation Support the evolution of JumpCloud’s outbound programs through AI targeting, signal-based prioritization, automated enrichment, and intelligent workflow orchestration. Ship Fast and Iterate Rapidly prototype, deploy, measure, and improve GTM workflows with a strong bias toward execution and measurable business impact. We're Looking For: A highly technical GTM operator who enjoys building systems, automations, and workflows that solve real revenue problems. This person thrives in fast-moving environments, is comfortable working across both strategy and execution, and prefers shipping solutions over discussing hypotheticals. Success in this role is measured by deployed workflows and operational improvements that increase outbound efficiency, pipeline generation, or seller productivity. Required Qualifications: GTM Systems & Operations Hands-on experience working within modern GTM systems including Salesforce, Marketo, Gong Engage, enrichment providers, and outbound engagement platforms. Experience building and maintaining workflows across tools such as Clay, Openprise, Zapier, Replit, or similar orchestration platforms. Strong understanding of outbound operations, lead/account flows, enrichment strategies, segmentation, and GTM data management. In-depth understanding of how MCPs work and demonstrated experience applying best practices for MCP utilization and efficiency. AI & Automation Practical experience applying AI and automation to GTM workflows beyond experimentation. Experience working with LLMs (preferably Claude Cowork & Code), prompt workflows, structured outputs, AI-assisted personalization, and integrating AI outputs into operational systems. Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, webhooks, and lightweight scripting to connect systems and automate processes. Understanding of concepts such as agentic workflows, signal-based automation, RAG, embeddings, or AI orchestration frameworks is a plus. Builder Mentality Proven ability to independently build and operationalize workflows from idea → deployment → iteration. Comfortable using no-code, low-code, and lightweight coding approaches to deliver solutions quickly. Strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to identify bottlenecks and improve workflow reliability at scale. Cross-Functional Collaboration Ability to partner effectively with Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Data teams to align priorities and execute quickly. Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Operating Style Highly self-directed and execution-oriented with a strong bias toward action. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and iterating quickly as priorities evolve. Motivated by solving operational problems and building systems that create measurable business impact. Shift Availability: This role will align with an EMEA shift schedule, roughy 1:00pm - 10:00 pm IST \n #LI-YA1 Where you’ll be working/Location: JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description. This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role. Language: JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description. Why JumpCloud®? If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about. One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time. JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Scam Notice: Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment. All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice" #LI-Remote #BI-Remote

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst - Customer Experience & Partner Operations
jobs.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries , Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively , including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - Build the operating backbone for Customer Experience and Partnerships by ensuring our processes, systems, and data work together seamlessly. You’ll own the instrumentation of key workflows in HubSpot, establish reliable metrics and reporting, maintain operational hygiene, and turn GTM data into clear insights for the teams making decisions. The goal is simple: make CS and Partnerships easier to operate, easier to measure, and easier to scale. \n Where you'll leave your mark? Own the Customer Success Operations including CX process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of CX processes, workflows and process adherence Owning of key metrics definition and periodic (Weekly, monthly, quarterly) reporting including renewal, retention, upsells, GDR, NDR, Logo retention Own the Partnership Operations including Partnership process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of Partnership processes, workflows and process adherence Build and maintain partner pipeline and program reporting Support recurring GTM operations requests across both CS and Partnerships including variable pay calculations, adhoc data requests The kind of builder we're looking for - 3-5 years of experience in Revenue Operations preferably in Customer Success and/or Partnership Operations Hands-on experience with Hubspot including building workflows, properties, reports and dashboards Working fluency in SaaS metrics - ARR, MRR, GDR, NDR, Churn, Partner sourced and Partner influenced ARR Demonstrated experience in maintaining data hygiene and catching errors / process deviances Ability to learn new AI tools, technologies and processes Strong attention to detail and ability to collaborate effectively with various stakeholders \n How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are : We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house : If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning : We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves : Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams : We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

needs_verification.title: Clinical Data Management Associate II
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: Clinical Data Management: Support the implementation and execution of clinical data management plans for assigned medical imaging studies, ensuring data collection and management activities meet project requirements. Study Documentation Review: Review study documentation, protocols, and project requirements to assess their impact on data management processes, standards, and deliverables. Data Validation & Quality Control: Define, develop, execute, review, and maintain edit checks to identify inconsistencies, discrepancies, and missing information while ensuring clinical data accuracy and completeness. Clinical Data Review: Analyze clinical and imaging-related datasets to identify data quality issues, trends, inconsistencies, and potential errors requiring investigation. Data Specifications & System Configuration: Develop and maintain study-specific documentation, including data transfer specifications, system configuration specifications, and data validation requirements. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with project teams and operational stakeholders to support study setup, data collection strategies, and changing project requirements. Issue Management & Resolution: Investigate data discrepancies, coordinate resolution activities, track outstanding issues, and ensure timely follow-up with relevant stakeholders. Reporting & Data Deliverables: Prepare, review, validate, and deliver ad hoc data listings, study reports, and other data-related outputs according to project requirements. Documentation & Compliance: Create and maintain transmittal forms, study documentation, and accurate audit-ready records throughout the clinical study lifecycle. System & Process Improvements: Identify system defects, bugs, and opportunities for enhancements, coordinating with Product Management and relevant technical teams to support improvements. Stakeholder Communication: Provide regular updates on project progress, data quality concerns, potential risks, and outstanding issues to supervisors and project stakeholders. Continuous Improvement: Contribute to departmental improvement initiatives, standard operating procedure (SOP) updates, and quality enhancement activities. Regulatory Compliance: Ensure data management activities follow internal procedures, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and applicable regulatory and industry requirements. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Clinical Research, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. At least 3 years of experience in Clinical Data Management, clinical research, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), or related healthcare environments. Good understanding of clinical trial processes, clinical data review methodologies, and clinical database management principles. Working knowledge of relational database concepts, data validation techniques, and quality control methodologies. Experience developing or maintaining data specifications, edit checks, data transfer requirements, or clinical study configuration documentation is preferred. Familiarity with clinical research terminology, medical imaging data, and regulated research environments. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, Access, Outlook, and PowerPoint. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to investigate discrepancies and resolve complex data quality issues. Exceptional attention to detail and a strong commitment to maintaining data accuracy, consistency, and integrity. Excellent organizational, documentation, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to communicate technical and project-related information clearly. Ability to work independently, demonstrate initiative, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams. A proactive, professional, and customer-focused approach, with a strong sense of accountability and commitment to continuous improvement. Ability to adapt to changing project requirements while maintaining high standards of quality and compliance. Benefits Competitive compensation package and performance-related incentives. Provident fund benefits. Medical insurance coverage. Flexible remote working opportunities within India. Access to modern office facilities and collaborative working environments. Employee engagement programs and local team events. Professional development and continuous learning opportunities. Career growth opportunities within an international organization. Exposure to global clinical research projects and medical imaging technologies. Opportunity to contribute to clinical studies supporting the development of life-changing therapies. Collaborative and purpose-driven work environment focused on scientific innovation and improving patient outcomes. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. #LI-CL1

needs_verification.title: Strategy and Operations Associate (Platform - Nishad)
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: Strategic Initiative Support: Assist in researching, analyzing, planning, and executing strategic projects and business initiatives. Help translate organizational priorities into structured plans and actionable recommendations. Data Analysis and Performance Monitoring: Conduct detailed quantitative and qualitative analyses, identify trends, monitor key performance indicators, and generate insights to support informed business decisions. Project Management and Execution: Develop project plans, establish success metrics, track milestones, monitor deliverables, and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure initiatives remain aligned with priorities and objectives. Process Improvement: Identify operational challenges, assess existing workflows, and contribute to developing and implementing practical solutions that improve efficiency and organizational performance. Reporting and Communication: Prepare clear and structured reports, presentations, dashboards, and performance updates to communicate project progress, analytical findings, and recommendations to leadership. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with teams across go-to-market, product, engineering, and data science to coordinate initiatives, resolve challenges, and drive progress toward shared business goals. Strategic Problem-Solving: Bring structure to ambiguous business challenges by conducting research, organizing information, evaluating opportunities, and supporting the development of effective solutions. Business Impact and Growth: Take ownership of meaningful projects and contribute to operational effectiveness, strategic execution, and broader organizational growth. Requirements Professional Experience: At least 3 years of experience in strategy, operations, business analytics, consulting, or a related field is preferred, particularly within high-growth startups or consulting environments. Educational Background: Strong academic qualifications or demonstrated professional excellence in a relevant discipline. Strategic and Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to break down complex challenges, identify relevant insights, and develop practical, data-driven recommendations. Data Analysis Expertise: Proven ability to analyze data, identify patterns and trends, interpret performance metrics, and translate findings into actionable business insights. Technical Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets. Familiarity with data analysis, reporting, dashboard creation, and business intelligence tools is an advantage. Project Management: Understanding of project planning, business operations, performance tracking, and execution methodologies, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and monitor deliverables. Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare structured presentations, communicate analytical findings, and engage effectively with different stakeholders. Collaboration and Relationship Building: Ability to work across multidisciplinary teams, establish productive relationships, and align stakeholders around common objectives. Adaptability and Initiative: A proactive, organized, and action-oriented mindset, with the ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Learning Agility: Strong curiosity and willingness to develop expertise across strategy, operations, technology, and emerging AI applications. Benefits Fully Remote Work: Opportunity to work remotely from India, with a five-day workweek and flexible working hours. High-Impact Responsibilities: Early ownership of meaningful projects and the opportunity to contribute to strategic initiatives from day one. Leadership Exposure: Direct collaboration with experienced professionals and senior leaders, providing valuable exposure to strategic decision-making. Cross-functional Learning: Opportunities to work across strategy, operations, product, engineering, data science, and go-to-market functions. AI Industry Exposure: Work at the forefront of AI innovation, supporting initiatives that help advance AI models through expert datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and research benchmarks. Research and Innovation: Opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge AI research and potentially showcase work at leading industry conferences, including ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS. Enterprise AI Experience: Exposure to applying advanced AI innovations to real-world business challenges and enterprise workflows. Exceptional Peer Network: Opportunity to collaborate with experienced professionals from leading technology companies and develop valuable industry connections. Fast-paced Environment: Experience working in a dynamic, startup-style setting that encourages ownership, agility, continuous learning, and professional growth. needs_verification.description: Accountabilities:: Own the day-to-day administration, maintenance, and optimization of the GoHighLevel CRM, including its structure, fields, lifecycle stages, pipelines, and workflows. Maintain CRM data quality and ensure that commercial processes and customer journeys are accurately reflected in the platform. Build and improve automated workflows, lead routing, notifications, and integrations to streamline sales and marketing operations. Support the execution of marketing campaigns, including email communications, lead nurturing, audience segmentation, and campaign tracking. Monitor campaign performance, lead generation, and conversion metrics, identifying opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness. Support lead generation and qualification by researching prospects, organizing leads, prioritizing opportunities, and assisting with follow-up activities. Partner with sales stakeholders to improve pipeline quality, conversion rates, sales activity, and visibility across the sales process. Build and maintain accessible commercial dashboards covering pipeline value, opportunity stages, lead generation, conversion rates, campaign performance, and revenue forecasts. Provide accurate, actionable reporting and analysis to support commercial meetings and decision-making. Contribute to broader revenue operations initiatives, including sales process improvement, forecasting support, commercial analytics, documentation, and sales and marketing alignment. Identify operational bottlenecks and recommend practical improvements across systems, processes, and workflows. Requirements: 3–5 years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, commercial operations, CRM management, or a related field. Strong practical experience with CRM platforms, ideally GoHighLevel, including both CRM administration and marketing automation. Demonstrated ability to build workflows, reports, dashboards, and automated processes. Regular, hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude, with curiosity about applying AI to improve productivity and operational efficiency. Experience supporting sales and/or marketing teams in a commercial environment. Good understanding of sales funnels, lead management, pipeline processes, and customer journeys. Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate commercial data into clear, useful business insights. Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and commitment to maintaining accurate data. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with sales, marketing, and leadership stakeholders. Ability to work independently, take ownership of responsibilities, and adapt to changing business needs. Nice to have: Familiarity with the US healthcare ecosystem, including employer benefits, health plans, brokers, or third-party administrators. Nice to have: Experience in B2B, SaaS, or technology environments; GoHighLevel certification; or running email and digital marketing campaigns. Nice to have: Knowledge of CRM integrations, commercial tools, forecasting, revenue analytics, or experience supporting US-based and international teams. needs_verification.title: Data & Systems Specialist
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: You will support the organization's data infrastructure and digital operations by maintaining system reliability, improving data quality, developing integrations, and delivering actionable insights to internal teams. Data Management & Quality Maintain data quality, consistency, completeness, and reliability across organizational systems. Perform data cleaning, validation, transformation, deduplication, and reconciliation. Manage data imports, exports, migrations, and bulk updates. Identify data quality issues and collaborate with relevant stakeholders to resolve root causes. Support the implementation of data standards, structures, and governance practices. Handle confidential and sensitive information in accordance with security requirements and organizational policies. Data Systems & CRM Administration Support the administration and effective use of key platforms, including Salesforce CRM, Mailchimp, registration and selection systems, and related tools. Configure and maintain system fields, forms, workflows, reports, and user views. Assist internal users with data-related questions, troubleshooting, and platform adoption. Investigate system issues, identify root causes, and implement appropriate solutions. Conduct testing and quality assurance when systems, workflows, or integrations are introduced or updated. Maintain technical documentation and contribute to internal user training. Integrations & Automation Build, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot integrations and automated workflows between platforms. Work with REST APIs, webhooks, automation platforms, and related integration technologies. Map, transform, and synchronize data across different systems and structures. Monitor automated processes and investigate failures, inconsistencies, or unexpected results. Identify repetitive processes that could be simplified or improved through automation. Collaborate with technical leadership to implement scalable, maintainable solutions. Reporting & Business Intelligence Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and data visualizations for internal teams and organizational leadership. Produce accurate and timely ad hoc reports using organizational data systems. Extract, validate, and analyze data using SQL, spreadsheets, CRM reporting tools, and other analytical technologies. Maintain consistent reporting definitions and ensure the accuracy of performance metrics. Help non-technical stakeholders interpret data and turn findings into actionable insights. Digital & Engagement Analytics Analyze digital engagement across websites, email campaigns, registrations, events, and other participant touchpoints. Measure audience engagement, conversion rates, participation, and campaign performance. Collaborate with relevant teams to ensure appropriate data is available to evaluate digital initiatives. Deliver recurring and project-specific reports to identify trends and improvement opportunities. AI, Automation & Emerging Technology Use AI tools responsibly to improve data analysis, documentation, operational workflows, and productivity. Support the development and maintenance of AI-enabled workflows and data processes where appropriate. Explore emerging technologies that could improve data operations and organizational effectiveness. Test, evaluate, and document new approaches before broader implementation. Ensure AI-related activities comply with applicable privacy, security, and data governance requirements. Project & Team Support Support the Data and Technology Lead in delivering data and technology projects. Translate defined business and operational requirements into technical tasks and practical solutions. Collaborate with internal teams, contractors, vendors, and volunteers. Track tasks, dependencies, issues, and deliverables using appropriate project management tools. Participate in Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or other delivery processes. Maintain clear technical and process documentation to support long-term system reliability and knowledge sharing. Requirements The ideal candidate combines hands-on experience in data management, CRM administration, integrations, and reporting with strong analytical skills and the ability to collaborate across international teams. The role also requires alignment with the organization's Christian mission and values. Education & Professional Experience Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field preferred. At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in data management, analytics, CRM administration, and reporting. Experience working with APIs and technologies such as Salesforce, Google Workspace, SQL, data visualization platforms, automation and integration tools, and project management systems is preferred. Experience in a multinational organization or international nonprofit environment is an advantage. Technical Skills Demonstrated competency with databases, CRM systems, data integrations, reporting, and related data technologies. Working knowledge of SQL or similar query languages. Strong proficiency in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets. Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, automation platforms, and system integrations. Experience with CRM platforms, with Salesforce strongly preferred. Familiarity with email marketing, registration, event management, or constituent management systems. Ability to create reports, dashboards, and data visualizations. Effective and responsible use of AI tools, with an openness to emerging technologies. Professional & Interpersonal Skills Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting abilities, with excellent attention to detail. Proactive, solutions-oriented approach to identifying and resolving technical issues. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and assignments. Ability to document technical processes clearly and consistently. Capacity to explain technical information to non-technical audiences. Strong relationship-building and collaboration skills across departments, cultures, and time zones. Discretion and sound judgment when handling confidential information. Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. Curious, adaptable, teachable, and willing to learn new technologies and approaches. Spiritual Alignment Committed follower of Jesus Christ. Affirmation of the Lausanne Covenant. Demonstrates Christian character, integrity, humility, and a servant-hearted approach to work and collaboration. Ability to engage respectfully and sensitively with people from diverse Christian theological, denominational, cultural, and geographical backgrounds within the global Christian community. Alignment with the mission, vision, and values of the organization. Benefits Fully remote, full-time position, open to candidates worldwide with a reliable internet connection. Flexibility to work from anywhere while collaborating effectively across multiple time zones. Opportunity to contribute to a global mission through data, technology, and digital transformation. Exposure to international projects and collaboration with globally distributed staff, contractors, partners, and volunteers. Opportunity to work with modern data systems, CRM platforms, integrations, automation, and emerging AI technologies. Close collaboration with the Data and Technology Lead and teams across the organization. Potential for a small amount of international travel. No salary range or specific healthcare, retirement, or additional financial benefits disclosed. needs_verification.title: Professional, Product Support
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities:: Provide production support for PeopleSoft Financial Management 9.2, investigating and resolving complex issues across financial modules and associated third-party applications. Monitor system performance, data integrity, user experience, and scheduled batch processes to identify potential problems and prevent operational disruptions. Manage incidents according to business priorities and service-level agreements, performing root cause analysis and implementing permanent solutions to prevent recurring issues. Review, test, and implement system configuration changes, including security settings, application updates, and onboarding of new business entities. Support critical financial activities, particularly month-end and quarter-end closing processes, ensuring system availability and timely resolution of business-impacting issues. Collaborate with finance and accounting stakeholders to gather requirements, conduct gap analyses, assess business and technical impacts, and translate needs into functional specifications. Contribute to system enhancements, new module implementations, integrations, and functionality rollouts across multiple business units and geographical regions. Design and execute user acceptance testing, regression testing, test scenarios, and data validation activities to ensure the quality and reliability of system changes. Use SQL, PSQuery, and other analytical tools to investigate data discrepancies, troubleshoot technical issues, and support system performance assessments. Develop and maintain functional specifications, technical documentation, process guides, and end-user training materials. Provide expert guidance to business users, support knowledge transfer, and mentor junior team members and colleagues across IT functions. Collaborate with Oracle support teams and third-party vendors to resolve technical issues and evaluate new functionalities. Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, process optimization, predictive monitoring, and emerging technologies, including generative AI. Support escalated critical incidents, working closely with Level 2 and higher technical support teams to ensure timely resolution. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related discipline. 3–5 years of experience supporting PeopleSoft Financial Management 9.2 within an enterprise IT environment. Strong functional knowledge of PeopleSoft Financial and Supply Chain Management (FSCM) 9.2 modules and production support methodologies. Hands-on experience with system monitoring, incident management, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis. Proficiency in SQL and PSQuery for data investigation, system analysis, and rapid issue resolution. Good understanding of financial processes, particularly month-end closing, financial reporting, and enterprise accounting operations. Experience supporting system configurations, integrations, enhancements, and third-party financial applications. Knowledge of user acceptance testing, regression testing, data validation, and software quality assurance practices. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with excellent attention to detail and a proactive approach to identifying operational risks. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and remain effective under pressure during critical business periods. Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate across global and cross-functional teams. Preferred qualifications: PeopleSoft Financial Management certifications. Experience with process automation tools and emerging technologies, particularly generative AI applications for IT support. Familiarity with predictive analytics, proactive monitoring, and system optimization solutions. Previous experience mentoring technical teams or leading cross-functional initiatives. Exposure to enterprise financial systems and related business processes. Benefits: Remote working opportunity based in Bengaluru, India. Full-time position with a standard 40-hour working week. Opportunity to work with large-scale enterprise financial systems supporting global operations. Exposure to advanced technologies, automation, predictive analytics, and AI-driven IT support solutions. Opportunities to develop technical expertise in PeopleSoft Financial Management and enterprise application support. Professional growth through collaboration with international teams and experienced technology specialists. Opportunities to contribute to process improvements, system enhancements, and strategic technology initiatives. Generate insights and recommendations that help drive increased product adoption and customer value realization. Proactively flag low-utilization accounts and collaborate with Account Managers (AMs) to improve engagement. Prepare regular reports and dashboards to track customer success metrics. Ensure customer inquiries are accurately documented and followed through to completion. Maintain high customer satisfaction standards throughout every interaction. Customer Health Monitoring Maintain and update customer health dashboards and account records. Set up product demonstrations and trial environments for prospective and existing customers. Support onboarding activities for new customer users. Ensure customer user access and permissions are maintained accurately. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Support teams to ensure a seamless customer experience. Contribute to process improvements and operational efficiencies within the Customer Success organization. Assist in documenting customer success workflows, procedures, and best practices Job Details: 2+ years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Operations, SaaS Operations, Support, or a related role. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret customer usage data and identify actionable insights. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: Support the development and implementation of AI, Machine Learning, and Generative AI solutions for business applications. Collaborate with senior engineers to build LLM-powered applications, chatbots, AI assistants, and knowledge management solutions. Develop Python scripts, applications, APIs, and reusable AI components. Explore and implement prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, and LLM integrations. Assist with structured and unstructured data preparation, processing, and analysis. Integrate AI capabilities into enterprise applications using REST APIs and other technologies. Support application testing, debugging, performance optimization, and deployment activities. Collaborate with UX/UI designers and software development teams to create intuitive AI-powered user experiences. Contribute to AI-enabled features within enterprise portals and platforms, including Liferay. Support responsive web development using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap. Participate in Agile ceremonies, code reviews, technical discussions, and documentation. Adhere to enterprise standards for software development, data privacy, information security, and responsible AI. At least 1 year of experience in software development, AI/ML, data science, or a related technical field. Good working knowledge of Python and fundamental software development concepts. Basic understanding of AI/ML, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Generative AI, and Large Language Models. Familiarity with prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, and vector search concepts. Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP, and application integration. Basic knowledge of SQL and relational databases. Understanding of object-oriented programming and software engineering fundamentals. Familiarity with Git or other version control tools. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and debugging abilities. Effective communication, teamwork, and collaboration skills. Benefits: Hybrid working arrangement, combining onsite and offsite work. Group health insurance. Group term life insurance. strong_shortlist.title: Revenue Operations Analyst - Customer Experience & Partner Operations
strong_shortlist.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries , Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively , including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - Build the operating backbone for Customer Experience and Partnerships by ensuring our processes, systems, and data work together seamlessly. You’ll own the instrumentation of key workflows in HubSpot, establish reliable metrics and reporting, maintain operational hygiene, and turn GTM data into clear insights for the teams making decisions. The goal is simple: make CS and Partnerships easier to operate, easier to measure, and easier to scale. \n Where you'll leave your mark? Own the Customer Success Operations including CX process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of CX processes, workflows and process adherence Owning of key metrics definition and periodic (Weekly, monthly, quarterly) reporting including renewal, retention, upsells, GDR, NDR, Logo retention Own the Partnership Operations including Partnership process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of Partnership processes, workflows and process adherence Build and maintain partner pipeline and program reporting Support recurring GTM operations requests across both CS and Partnerships including variable pay calculations, adhoc data requests The kind of builder we're looking for - 3-5 years of experience in Revenue Operations preferably in Customer Success and/or Partnership Operations Hands-on experience with Hubspot including building workflows, properties, reports and dashboards Working fluency in SaaS metrics - ARR, MRR, GDR, NDR, Churn, Partner sourced and Partner influenced ARR Demonstrated experience in maintaining data hygiene and catching errors / process deviances Ability to learn new AI tools, technologies and processes Strong attention to detail and ability to collaborate effectively with various stakeholders \n How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are : We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house : If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning : We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves : Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams : We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

review_queue.title: Clinical Data Management Associate II
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: Clinical Data Management: Support the implementation and execution of clinical data management plans for assigned medical imaging studies, ensuring data collection and management activities meet project requirements. Study Documentation Review: Review study documentation, protocols, and project requirements to assess their impact on data management processes, standards, and deliverables. Data Validation & Quality Control: Define, develop, execute, review, and maintain edit checks to identify inconsistencies, discrepancies, and missing information while ensuring clinical data accuracy and completeness. Clinical Data Review: Analyze clinical and imaging-related datasets to identify data quality issues, trends, inconsistencies, and potential errors requiring investigation. Data Specifications & System Configuration: Develop and maintain study-specific documentation, including data transfer specifications, system configuration specifications, and data validation requirements. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with project teams and operational stakeholders to support study setup, data collection strategies, and changing project requirements. Issue Management & Resolution: Investigate data discrepancies, coordinate resolution activities, track outstanding issues, and ensure timely follow-up with relevant stakeholders. Reporting & Data Deliverables: Prepare, review, validate, and deliver ad hoc data listings, study reports, and other data-related outputs according to project requirements. Documentation & Compliance: Create and maintain transmittal forms, study documentation, and accurate audit-ready records throughout the clinical study lifecycle. System & Process Improvements: Identify system defects, bugs, and opportunities for enhancements, coordinating with Product Management and relevant technical teams to support improvements. Stakeholder Communication: Provide regular updates on project progress, data quality concerns, potential risks, and outstanding issues to supervisors and project stakeholders. Continuous Improvement: Contribute to departmental improvement initiatives, standard operating procedure (SOP) updates, and quality enhancement activities. Regulatory Compliance: Ensure data management activities follow internal procedures, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and applicable regulatory and industry requirements. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Clinical Research, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. At least 3 years of experience in Clinical Data Management, clinical research, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), or related healthcare environments. Good understanding of clinical trial processes, clinical data review methodologies, and clinical database management principles. Working knowledge of relational database concepts, data validation techniques, and quality control methodologies. Experience developing or maintaining data specifications, edit checks, data transfer requirements, or clinical study configuration documentation is preferred. Familiarity with clinical research terminology, medical imaging data, and regulated research environments. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, Access, Outlook, and PowerPoint. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to investigate discrepancies and resolve complex data quality issues. Exceptional attention to detail and a strong commitment to maintaining data accuracy, consistency, and integrity. Excellent organizational, documentation, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to communicate technical and project-related information clearly. Ability to work independently, demonstrate initiative, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams. A proactive, professional, and customer-focused approach, with a strong sense of accountability and commitment to continuous improvement. Ability to adapt to changing project requirements while maintaining high standards of quality and compliance. Benefits Competitive compensation package and performance-related incentives. Provident fund benefits. Medical insurance coverage. Flexible remote working opportunities within India. Access to modern office facilities and collaborative working environments. Employee engagement programs and local team events. Professional development and continuous learning opportunities. Career growth opportunities within an international organization. Exposure to global clinical research projects and medical imaging technologies. Opportunity to contribute to clinical studies supporting the development of life-changing therapies. Collaborative and purpose-driven work environment focused on scientific innovation and improving patient outcomes. review_queue.title: Strategy and Operations Associate (Platform - Nishad)
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: Strategic Initiative Support: Assist in researching, analyzing, planning, and executing strategic projects and business initiatives. Help translate organizational priorities into structured plans and actionable recommendations. Data Analysis and Performance Monitoring: Conduct detailed quantitative and qualitative analyses, identify trends, monitor key performance indicators, and generate insights to support informed business decisions. Project Management and Execution: Develop project plans, establish success metrics, track milestones, monitor deliverables, and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure initiatives remain aligned with priorities and objectives. Process Improvement: Identify operational challenges, assess existing workflows, and contribute to developing and implementing practical solutions that improve efficiency and organizational performance. Reporting and Communication: Prepare clear and structured reports, presentations, dashboards, and performance updates to communicate project progress, analytical findings, and recommendations to leadership. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with teams across go-to-market, product, engineering, and data science to coordinate initiatives, resolve challenges, and drive progress toward shared business goals. Strategic Problem-Solving: Bring structure to ambiguous business challenges by conducting research, organizing information, evaluating opportunities, and supporting the development of effective solutions. Business Impact and Growth: Take ownership of meaningful projects and contribute to operational effectiveness, strategic execution, and broader organizational growth. Requirements Professional Experience: At least 3 years of experience in strategy, operations, business analytics, consulting, or a related field is preferred, particularly within high-growth startups or consulting environments. review_queue.title: Data & Systems Specialist
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: You will support the organization's data infrastructure and digital operations by maintaining system reliability, improving data quality, developing integrations, and delivering actionable insights to internal teams. Data Management & Quality Maintain data quality, consistency, completeness, and reliability across organizational systems. Perform data cleaning, validation, transformation, deduplication, and reconciliation. Manage data imports, exports, migrations, and bulk updates. Identify data quality issues and collaborate with relevant stakeholders to resolve root causes. Support the implementation of data standards, structures, and governance practices. Handle confidential and sensitive information in accordance with security requirements and organizational policies. Data Systems & CRM Administration Support the administration and effective use of key platforms, including Salesforce CRM, Mailchimp, registration and selection systems, and related tools. Configure and maintain system fields, forms, workflows, reports, and user views. Assist internal users with data-related questions, troubleshooting, and platform adoption. Investigate system issues, identify root causes, and implement appropriate solutions. Conduct testing and quality assurance when systems, workflows, or integrations are introduced or updated. Maintain technical documentation and contribute to internal user training. Integrations & Automation Build, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot integrations and automated workflows between platforms. Work with REST APIs, webhooks, automation platforms, and related integration technologies. Map, transform, and synchronize data across different systems and structures. Monitor automated processes and investigate failures, inconsistencies, or unexpected results. Identify repetitive processes that could be simplified or improved through automation. Collaborate with technical leadership to implement scalable, maintainable solutions. Reporting & Business Intelligence Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and data visualizations for internal teams and organizational leadership. Produce accurate and timely ad hoc reports using organizational data systems. Extract, validate, and analyze data using SQL, spreadsheets, CRM reporting tools, and other analytical technologies. Maintain consistent reporting definitions and ensure the accuracy of performance metrics. Help non-technical stakeholders interpret data and turn findings into actionable insights. Digital & Engagement Analytics Analyze digital engagement across websites, email campaigns, registrations, events, and other participant touchpoints. Measure audience engagement, conversion rates, participation, and campaign performance. Collaborate with relevant teams to ensure appropriate data is available to evaluate digital initiatives. Deliver recurring and project-specific reports to identify trends and improvement opportunities. AI, Automation & Emerging Technology Use AI tools responsibly to improve data analysis, documentation, operational workflows, and productivity. Support the development and maintenance of AI-enabled workflows and data processes where appropriate. Explore emerging technologies that could improve data operations and organizational effectiveness. Test, evaluate, and document new approaches before broader implementation. Ensure AI-related activities comply with applicable privacy, security, and data governance requirements. Project & Team Support Support the Data and Technology Lead in delivering data and technology projects. Translate defined business and operational requirements into technical tasks and practical solutions. Collaborate with internal teams, contractors, vendors, and volunteers. Track tasks, dependencies, issues, and deliverables using appropriate project management tools. Participate in Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or other delivery processes. Maintain clear technical and process documentation to support long-term system reliability and knowledge sharing. Requirements The ideal candidate combines hands-on experience in data management, CRM administration, integrations, and reporting with strong analytical skills and the ability to collaborate across international teams. The role also requires alignment with the organization's Christian mission and values. Education & Professional Experience Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field preferred. At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in data management, analytics, CRM administration, and reporting. Experience working with APIs and technologies such as Salesforce, Google Workspace, SQL, data visualization platforms, automation and integration tools, and project management systems is preferred. Experience in a multinational organization or international nonprofit environment is an advantage. Technical Skills Demonstrated competency with databases, CRM systems, data integrations, reporting, and related data technologies. Working knowledge of SQL or similar query languages. Strong proficiency in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets. Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, automation platforms, and system integrations. Experience with CRM platforms, with Salesforce strongly preferred. Familiarity with email marketing, registration, event management, or constituent management systems. Ability to create reports, dashboards, and data visualizations. Effective and responsible use of AI tools, with an openness to emerging technologies. Professional & Interpersonal Skills Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting abilities, with excellent attention to detail. Proactive, solutions-oriented approach to identifying and resolving technical issues. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and assignments. Ability to document technical processes clearly and consistently. Capacity to explain technical information to non-technical audiences. Strong relationship-building and collaboration skills across departments, cultures, and time zones. Discretion and sound judgment when handling confidential information. Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. Curious, adaptable, teachable, and willing to learn new technologies and approaches. Spiritual Alignment Committed follower of Jesus Christ. Affirmation of the Lausanne Covenant. Demonstrates Christian character, integrity, humility, and a servant-hearted approach to work and collaboration. Ability to engage respectfully and sensitively with people from diverse Christian theological, denominational, cultural, and geographical backgrounds within the global Christian community. Alignment with the mission, vision, and values of the organization. Benefits Fully remote, full-time position, open to candidates worldwide with a reliable internet connection. Flexibility to work from anywhere while collaborating effectively across multiple time zones. Opportunity to contribute to a global mission through data, technology, and digital transformation. Exposure to international projects and collaboration with globally distributed staff, contractors, partners, and volunteers. Opportunity to work with modern data systems, CRM platforms, integrations, automation, and emerging AI technologies. Close collaboration with the Data and Technology Lead and teams across the organization. Potential for a small amount of international travel. review_queue.title: Sales Operations Analyst
review_queue.description: Job Description At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members. Operating with empathy and compassion, First Advantage fosters a global inclusive workforce devoted to the diverse voices that make up our talent and products. Our team members empower each other to be their authentic selves and treat all with respect, integrity, and fairness. Say hello to a rewarding career, and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands. The Sales Operations Analyst supports the GTM, with ownership of ACV performance (Pipeline and Bookings) and Revenue performance (post‑booking). This role partners closely with General Managers, their leadership teams, and their GTM stakeholders to drive visibility into pipeline health, forecast accuracy, and revenue realization, ensuring disciplined execution across the commercial lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Own annual planning for pipeline modeling and Booked ACV targets, including ongoing performance analysis across Pipeline ACV, Booked ACV, and Revenue Monitor adherence to pipeline and forecast standards, identifying risks, gaps, and performance trends Monitor and report on core performance KPIs including: Sales Cycle, ASP (Average Selling Price), Win Rates Analyze pipeline health including coverage, velocity, aging, conversion, and slippage Support weekly pipeline and operating reviews, providing data and performance insight Partner with GMs on rep and team performance, identifying execution gaps and improvement opportunities Provide insight into how pipeline and bookings quality impact downstream revenue realization Collaborate with Finance and Marketing Operations to support alignment across pipeline, bookings, and revenue. Provide performance analysis and business insight to support segmentation and planning decisions Partner with Revenue Technology and Sales Operations to support reporting and analytics requirements related to CRM enhancements Continuously improve reporting, dashboards, and analysis that support GM decision-making Explore and adopt ways AI and advanced analytics can improve forecasting, performance insight, and execution rigor About You You are a business‑minded analytics partner who understands the connection between pipeline execution, ACV bookings, and realized revenue through usage. You are comfortable working directly with GMs, Sales, and Customer Success leaders, and you use data to drive clarity and action. You bring: Strong understanding of ACV‑based sales models and usage‑based revenue Ability to translate data into clear, practical insights Comfort operating in a GM‑led Sales + Customer Success environment Hands-on experience using AI to improve performance analytics, reporting, or forecasting workflows You know how to spot operational friction and turn it into clearer process, better reporting, and stronger execution. A bias toward clarity, rigor, and accountability Experience & Qualifications 7+ Years of experience in Revenue Performance, Sales Analytics, or Revenue Operations Strong working knowledge of Revenue Tech Stack (e.g., Salesforce, Gong Forecasting, , ZoomInfo). Experience with BI platforms (e.g., Power BI) Intermediate or better Experience with Excel, PowerPoint, and other MS tools. Experience supporting pipeline reviews and performance discussions Why First Advantage is Your Next Big Career Move First Advantage is going through a technology transformation! We are looking for experts who are excited to work with advanced technologies and provide best-in-class user experiences, drive the development and deployment of scalable solutions, and smoothly guide our agile teams and clients through meaningful changes as we continue to expand our impact. What Are You Waiting For? Apply Today! You have learned a little about us today – we want to learn about you! If you think this position and our company are a great fit for your areas of interest and expertise, tell us about you by applying now! We have great people here and are looking for more. Come join us! Fraud Alert First Advantage does not charge candidates any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. We will never ask you to make a payment, purchase equipment, transfer money, or provide financial account information to obtain employment. If anyone claiming to represent First Advantage requests payment or other financial information, please treat the communication as suspicious and contact us through this website for verification. Follow us: Facebook Instagram LinkedIn X YouTube Equal Employment Opportunities at First Advantage First Advantage is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a workplace and recruitment process that is free from unlawful discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. Employment decisions at First Advantage are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate in any aspect of employment on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, religion, creed, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital or family status, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. review_queue.title: Data Officer
review_queue.description: Accountabilities:: Data Management and Infrastructure: Develop, maintain, and improve digital data collection systems, automated data pipelines, and data transformation workflows using tools such as SurveyCTO, Google Sheets, Airbyte, BigQuery, and dbt. Ensure data availability, consistency, accuracy, and usability across different systems by maintaining data models, troubleshooting technical issues, and improving infrastructure reliability and cost-effectiveness. Data Quality, Analysis, and Reporting: Design and implement data quality checks, automated validations, and monitoring mechanisms to identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and support timely issue resolution. Analyze programmatic and operational datasets, develop dashboards and reports, and generate actionable insights to support organizational monitoring, evaluation, reporting, and decision-making. Data Governance and Security: Support data governance practices, including access controls, data storage, backups, security, and documentation, ensuring responsible data management and compliance with internal policies. Conduct data audits and identify opportunities to improve existing systems, streamline manual processes, and introduce automation, AI, and other relevant technologies. Project Implementation: Contribute to predictive premix stock monitoring by analyzing historical stock, production, and consumption data to identify potential stockouts, ageing inventory, and reporting discrepancies. Support the implementation of data systems audit recommendations by strengthening data security, access management, auditability, and long-term data management practices. Collaboration and Technical Support: Work closely with quality, program, research, and operational teams to understand requirements and develop practical data solutions. Provide technical guidance on data collection tools, reporting systems, and data interpretation, while supporting research and evaluation activities through data preparation, validation, and analysis. Document workflows, communicate progress, and contribute to continuous improvements in organizational data systems and processes. Requirements: A Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or another relevant discipline. Candidates from other academic backgrounds with strong technical skills and relevant experience are also encouraged to apply. At least 2 years of experience managing the end-to-end data lifecycle, including data collection, processing, transformation, analysis, and reporting. Strong proficiency in advanced SQL and spreadsheet applications such as Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including complex queries, formulas, data manipulation, and analytical techniques. Familiarity with data collection platforms, data integration tools, cloud data warehouses, and transformation technologies such as SurveyCTO, Airbyte, BigQuery, and dbt is an advantage. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate data inconsistencies, identify root causes, and develop practical solutions. Ability to translate business and operational requirements into structured tasks and deliver accurate, well-documented outputs within agreed timelines. Excellent organizational and project coordination skills, including the ability to define actionable tasks, monitor milestones, and coordinate with relevant stakeholders. Strong attention to detail, accountability, and ownership when managing datasets, completing assignments, and maintaining technical documentation. Effective communication skills in English, both written and spoken, with the ability to explain technical issues, analytical findings, data limitations, and project progress clearly. Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, understand different operational needs, incorporate feedback, and support colleagues in using data tools. A proactive learning mindset, with curiosity and willingness to explore new technologies, analytical methods, AI applications, and automation solutions while critically evaluating their accuracy and limitations. Experience working remotely, independently, or within an NGO or development-sector environment is an advantage. Proficiency in both Hindi and English, written and spoken, is desirable. A genuine interest in improving public health and contributing to initiatives that create measurable social impact. Benefits: Monthly Compensation: INR 80,555 per month. Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from anywhere in India. Flexible Working Hours: Enjoy flexible scheduling to support productivity and a healthy work-life balance. Career Growth Opportunities: Take on new responsibilities, develop technical expertise, and explore opportunities to progress into leadership roles. Professional Development: Access mentorship, regular feedback, training, workshops, and learning resources to support continuous growth. Inclusive and Supportive Culture: Join a collaborative environment that values diverse perspectives, mutual respect, and teamwork. Meaningful Social Impact: Contribute directly to improving nutrition and public health through initiatives focused on reducing iron deficiency anaemia and expanding access to micronutrient-rich wheat flour. Learning and Cross-Functional Exposure: Work alongside different teams and develop a broader understanding of data systems, research, program implementation, and public health initiatives. Transparent Work Environment: Benefit from structured performance reviews, clear expectations, regular communication, and visible development opportunities. Remote Team Engagement: Participate in virtual social activities and team initiatives designed to strengthen collaboration and connection. How Jobgether works: We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. #LI-CL1

review_queue.description: Accountabilities:: Provide production support for PeopleSoft Financial Management 9.2, investigating and resolving complex issues across financial modules and associated third-party applications.
