Review, test, and implement system configuration changes, including security settings, application updates, and onboarding of new business entities. Support critical financial activities, particularly month-end and quarter-end closing processes, ensuring system availability and timely resolution of business-impacting issues. Collaborate with finance and accounting stakeholders to gather requirements, conduct gap analyses, assess business and technical impacts, and translate needs into functional specifications. Contribute to system enhancements, new module implementations, integrations, and functionality rollouts across multiple business units and geographical regions. Design and execute user acceptance testing, regression testing, test scenarios, and data validation activities to ensure the quality and reliability of system changes. Use SQL, PSQuery, and other analytical tools to investigate data discrepancies, troubleshoot technical issues, and support system performance assessments. Develop and maintain functional specifications, technical documentation, process guides, and end-user training materials. Provide expert guidance to business users, support knowledge transfer, and mentor junior team members and colleagues across IT functions. Collaborate with Oracle support teams and third-party vendors to resolve technical issues and evaluate new functionalities. Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, process optimization, predictive monitoring, and emerging technologies, including generative AI. Support escalated critical incidents, working closely with Level 2 and higher technical support teams to ensure timely resolution. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related discipline. 3–5 years of experience supporting PeopleSoft Financial Management 9.2 within an enterprise IT environment. Strong functional knowledge of PeopleSoft Financial and Supply Chain Management (FSCM) 9.2 modules and production support methodologies. Hands-on experience with system monitoring, incident management, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis. Proficiency in SQL and PSQuery for data investigation, system analysis, and rapid issue resolution. Good understanding of financial processes, particularly month-end closing, financial reporting, and enterprise accounting operations. Experience supporting system configurations, integrations, enhancements, and third-party financial applications. Knowledge of user acceptance testing, regression testing, data validation, and software quality assurance practices. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with excellent attention to detail and a proactive approach to identifying operational risks. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and remain effective under pressure during critical business periods. Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate across global and cross-functional teams. Preferred qualifications: PeopleSoft Financial Management certifications. Experience with process automation tools and emerging technologies, particularly generative AI applications for IT support. Familiarity with predictive analytics, proactive monitoring, and system optimization solutions. Previous experience mentoring technical teams or leading cross-functional initiatives. Exposure to enterprise financial systems and related business processes. Benefits: Remote working opportunity based in Bengaluru, India. Full-time position with a standard 40-hour working week. Opportunity to work with large-scale enterprise financial systems supporting global operations. Exposure to advanced technologies, automation, predictive analytics, and AI-driven IT support solutions. Professional growth through collaboration with international teams and experienced technology specialists. review_queue.description: Accountabilities: Support the development and implementation of AI, Machine Learning, and Generative AI solutions for business applications. Collaborate with senior engineers to build LLM-powered applications, chatbots, AI assistants, and knowledge management solutions. Develop Python scripts, applications, APIs, and reusable AI components. Explore and implement prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, and LLM integrations. Assist with structured and unstructured data preparation, processing, and analysis. Integrate AI capabilities into enterprise applications using REST APIs and other technologies. Support application testing, debugging, performance optimization, and deployment activities. Collaborate with UX/UI designers and software development teams to create intuitive AI-powered user experiences. Contribute to AI-enabled features within enterprise portals and platforms, including Liferay. Support responsive web development using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap. Participate in Agile ceremonies, code reviews, technical discussions, and documentation. Adhere to enterprise standards for software development, data privacy, information security, and responsible AI. Requirements: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related discipline. At least 1 year of experience in software development, AI/ML, data science, or a related technical field. Good working knowledge of Python and fundamental software development concepts. Basic understanding of AI/ML, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Generative AI, and Large Language Models. Familiarity with prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, and vector search concepts. Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP, and application integration. Basic knowledge of SQL and relational databases. Understanding of object-oriented programming and software engineering fundamentals. Familiarity with Git or other version control tools. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and debugging abilities. Effective communication, teamwork, and collaboration skills. Preferred qualifications: Exposure to LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar AI frameworks; experience with LLM-powered applications, chatbots, or AI assistants; understanding of model evaluation, hallucinations, semantic search, and responsible AI; familiarity with vector databases; knowledge of Liferay Portal/DXP and concepts such as portlets, widgets, sites, pages, content management, roles, and permissions; experience integrating enterprise applications through REST APIs; knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap; and exposure to Agile development practices. Benefits: Hybrid working arrangement, combining onsite and offsite work. Group health insurance. Group term life insurance. review_queue.description: Accountabilities:: Conduct basic data research and financial analyses to support business operations and provide findings and recommendations to managers and project leads. Prepare business, financial, and data analyses in collaboration with inventory management, information systems, financial auditing, and other internal departments. Review business dashboards and identify unusual performance patterns, emerging trends, and potential areas for improvement. Analyze market strategies, related products, market trends, and market share information to support business planning. Organize, plan, and recommend routine analytical activities and reports in accordance with established processes and procedures. Develop, create, and implement standardized reports to support recurring business reporting requirements. Monitor the accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of data used in business analyses and reports, escalating inconsistencies to the appropriate teams. Collect and consolidate business intelligence from industry reports, publicly available information, field reports, and external data sources. Follow up on analytical findings and reporting recommendations to ensure that results are reviewed and appropriate actions are implemented. Support departmental activities by completing specific operational and analytical assignments. Participate in due diligence and transition-related activities when required. Maintain and update business intelligence tools, databases, dashboards, systems, and reporting methodologies to ensure reliable and efficient analysis. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Mathematics, Applied Statistics, or a related field. Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to use SUM formulas, format spreadsheets, adjust column widths, insert charts, apply text wrapping, sort data, configure headers and footers, and prepare documents for printing. Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Access, including the ability to create and modify basic queries, adjust data types, add date fields, manage required fields, and create labels. Understanding of fundamental financial, accounting, and business problem-solving principles. Ability to apply standard financial and analytical techniques to business problems involving multiple variables. human_review.title: Sales Operations Analyst
human_review.description: Job Description At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members. Operating with empathy and compassion, First Advantage fosters a global inclusive workforce devoted to the diverse voices that make up our talent and products. Our team members empower each other to be their authentic selves and treat all with respect, integrity, and fairness. Say hello to a rewarding career, and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands. The Sales Operations Analyst supports the GTM, with ownership of ACV performance (Pipeline and Bookings) and Revenue performance (post‑booking). This role partners closely with General Managers, their leadership teams, and their GTM stakeholders to drive visibility into pipeline health, forecast accuracy, and revenue realization, ensuring disciplined execution across the commercial lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Own annual planning for pipeline modeling and Booked ACV targets, including ongoing performance analysis across Pipeline ACV, Booked ACV, and Revenue Monitor adherence to pipeline and forecast standards, identifying risks, gaps, and performance trends Monitor and report on core performance KPIs including: Sales Cycle, ASP (Average Selling Price), Win Rates Analyze pipeline health including coverage, velocity, aging, conversion, and slippage Support weekly pipeline and operating reviews, providing data and performance insight Partner with GMs on rep and team performance, identifying execution gaps and improvement opportunities Provide insight into how pipeline and bookings quality impact downstream revenue realization Collaborate with Finance and Marketing Operations to support alignment across pipeline, bookings, and revenue. Provide performance analysis and business insight to support segmentation and planning decisions Partner with Revenue Technology and Sales Operations to support reporting and analytics requirements related to CRM enhancements Continuously improve reporting, dashboards, and analysis that support GM decision-making Explore and adopt ways AI and advanced analytics can improve forecasting, performance insight, and execution rigor About You You are a business‑minded analytics partner who understands the connection between pipeline execution, ACV bookings, and realized revenue through usage. You are comfortable working directly with GMs, Sales, and Customer Success leaders, and you use data to drive clarity and action. You bring: Strong understanding of ACV‑based sales models and usage‑based revenue Ability to translate data into clear, practical insights Comfort operating in a GM‑led Sales + Customer Success environment Hands-on experience using AI to improve performance analytics, reporting, or forecasting workflows You know how to spot operational friction and turn it into clearer process, better reporting, and stronger execution. A bias toward clarity, rigor, and accountability Experience & Qualifications 7+ Years of experience in Revenue Performance, Sales Analytics, or Revenue Operations Strong working knowledge of Revenue Tech Stack (e.g., Salesforce, Gong Forecasting, , ZoomInfo). Experience with BI platforms (e.g., Power BI) Intermediate or better Experience with Excel, PowerPoint, and other MS tools. Experience supporting pipeline reviews and performance discussions Why First Advantage is Your Next Big Career Move First Advantage is going through a technology transformation! We are looking for experts who are excited to work with advanced technologies and provide best-in-class user experiences, drive the development and deployment of scalable solutions, and smoothly guide our agile teams and clients through meaningful changes as we continue to expand our impact. What Are You Waiting For? Apply Today! You have learned a little about us today – we want to learn about you! If you think this position and our company are a great fit for your areas of interest and expertise, tell us about you by applying now! We have great people here and are looking for more. Come join us! Fraud Alert First Advantage does not charge candidates any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. We will never ask you to make a payment, purchase equipment, transfer money, or provide financial account information to obtain employment. If anyone claiming to represent First Advantage requests payment or other financial information, please treat the communication as suspicious and contact us through this website for verification. Follow us: Facebook Instagram LinkedIn X YouTube Equal Employment Opportunities at First Advantage First Advantage is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a workplace and recruitment process that is free from unlawful discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. Employment decisions at First Advantage are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate in any aspect of employment on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, religion, creed, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital or family status, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. human_review.title: Clinical Data Management Associate II
human_review.description: Accountabilities: Clinical Data Management: Support the implementation and execution of clinical data management plans for assigned medical imaging studies, ensuring data collection and management activities meet project requirements. Study Documentation Review: Review study documentation, protocols, and project requirements to assess their impact on data management processes, standards, and deliverables. Data Validation & Quality Control: Define, develop, execute, review, and maintain edit checks to identify inconsistencies, discrepancies, and missing information while ensuring clinical data accuracy and completeness. Clinical Data Review: Analyze clinical and imaging-related datasets to identify data quality issues, trends, inconsistencies, and potential errors requiring investigation. Data Specifications & System Configuration: Develop and maintain study-specific documentation, including data transfer specifications, system configuration specifications, and data validation requirements. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with project teams and operational stakeholders to support study setup, data collection strategies, and changing project requirements. Issue Management & Resolution: Investigate data discrepancies, coordinate resolution activities, track outstanding issues, and ensure timely follow-up with relevant stakeholders. Reporting & Data Deliverables: Prepare, review, validate, and deliver ad hoc data listings, study reports, and other data-related outputs according to project requirements. Documentation & Compliance: Create and maintain transmittal forms, study documentation, and accurate audit-ready records throughout the clinical study lifecycle. System & Process Improvements: Identify system defects, bugs, and opportunities for enhancements, coordinating with Product Management and relevant technical teams to support improvements. Stakeholder Communication: Provide regular updates on project progress, data quality concerns, potential risks, and outstanding issues to supervisors and project stakeholders. Continuous Improvement: Contribute to departmental improvement initiatives, standard operating procedure (SOP) updates, and quality enhancement activities. Regulatory Compliance: Ensure data management activities follow internal procedures, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and applicable regulatory and industry requirements. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Clinical Research, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. At least 3 years of experience in Clinical Data Management, clinical research, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), or related healthcare environments. Good understanding of clinical trial processes, clinical data review methodologies, and clinical database management principles. Working knowledge of relational database concepts, data validation techniques, and quality control methodologies. Experience developing or maintaining data specifications, edit checks, data transfer requirements, or clinical study configuration documentation is preferred. Familiarity with clinical research terminology, medical imaging data, and regulated research environments. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, Access, Outlook, and PowerPoint. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to investigate discrepancies and resolve complex data quality issues. Exceptional attention to detail and a strong commitment to maintaining data accuracy, consistency, and integrity. Excellent organizational, documentation, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to communicate technical and project-related information clearly. Ability to work independently, demonstrate initiative, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams. A proactive, professional, and customer-focused approach, with a strong sense of accountability and commitment to continuous improvement. Ability to adapt to changing project requirements while maintaining high standards of quality and compliance. Benefits Competitive compensation package and performance-related incentives. Provident fund benefits. Medical insurance coverage. Flexible remote working opportunities within India. Access to modern office facilities and collaborative working environments. Employee engagement programs and local team events. Professional development and continuous learning opportunities. Career growth opportunities within an international organization. Exposure to global clinical research projects and medical imaging technologies. Opportunity to contribute to clinical studies supporting the development of life-changing therapies. Collaborative and purpose-driven work environment focused on scientific innovation and improving patient outcomes. Monitor campaign performance, lead generation, and conversion metrics, identifying opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness. Support lead generation and qualification by researching prospects, organizing leads, prioritizing opportunities, and assisting with follow-up activities. human_review.title: Data & Systems Specialist
human_review.description: Accountabilities: You will support the organization's data infrastructure and digital operations by maintaining system reliability, improving data quality, developing integrations, and delivering actionable insights to internal teams. Data Management & Quality Maintain data quality, consistency, completeness, and reliability across organizational systems. Perform data cleaning, validation, transformation, deduplication, and reconciliation. Manage data imports, exports, migrations, and bulk updates. Identify data quality issues and collaborate with relevant stakeholders to resolve root causes. Support the implementation of data standards, structures, and governance practices. Handle confidential and sensitive information in accordance with security requirements and organizational policies. Data Systems & CRM Administration Support the administration and effective use of key platforms, including Salesforce CRM, Mailchimp, registration and selection systems, and related tools. Configure and maintain system fields, forms, workflows, reports, and user views. Assist internal users with data-related questions, troubleshooting, and platform adoption. Investigate system issues, identify root causes, and implement appropriate solutions. Conduct testing and quality assurance when systems, workflows, or integrations are introduced or updated. Maintain technical documentation and contribute to internal user training. Integrations & Automation Build, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot integrations and automated workflows between platforms. Work with REST APIs, webhooks, automation platforms, and related integration technologies. Map, transform, and synchronize data across different systems and structures. Monitor automated processes and investigate failures, inconsistencies, or unexpected results. Identify repetitive processes that could be simplified or improved through automation. Collaborate with technical leadership to implement scalable, maintainable solutions. Reporting & Business Intelligence Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and data visualizations for internal teams and organizational leadership. Produce accurate and timely ad hoc reports using organizational data systems. Extract, validate, and analyze data using SQL, spreadsheets, CRM reporting tools, and other analytical technologies. Maintain consistent reporting definitions and ensure the accuracy of performance metrics. Help non-technical stakeholders interpret data and turn findings into actionable insights. Digital & Engagement Analytics Analyze digital engagement across websites, email campaigns, registrations, events, and other participant touchpoints. Measure audience engagement, conversion rates, participation, and campaign performance. Collaborate with relevant teams to ensure appropriate data is available to evaluate digital initiatives. Deliver recurring and project-specific reports to identify trends and improvement opportunities. AI, Automation & Emerging Technology Use AI tools responsibly to improve data analysis, documentation, operational workflows, and productivity. Support the development and maintenance of AI-enabled workflows and data processes where appropriate. Explore emerging technologies that could improve data operations and organizational effectiveness. Test, evaluate, and document new approaches before broader implementation. Ensure AI-related activities comply with applicable privacy, security, and data governance requirements. Project & Team Support Support the Data and Technology Lead in delivering data and technology projects. Translate defined business and operational requirements into technical tasks and practical solutions. Collaborate with internal teams, contractors, vendors, and volunteers. Track tasks, dependencies, issues, and deliverables using appropriate project management tools. Participate in Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or other delivery processes. Maintain clear technical and process documentation to support long-term system reliability and knowledge sharing. Requirements The ideal candidate combines hands-on experience in data management, CRM administration, integrations, and reporting with strong analytical skills and the ability to collaborate across international teams. The role also requires alignment with the organization's Christian mission and values. Education & Professional Experience Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field preferred. At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in data management, analytics, CRM administration, and reporting. Experience working with APIs and technologies such as Salesforce, Google Workspace, SQL, data visualization platforms, automation and integration tools, and project management systems is preferred. Experience in a multinational organization or international nonprofit environment is an advantage. Technical Skills Demonstrated competency with databases, CRM systems, data integrations, reporting, and related data technologies. Working knowledge of SQL or similar query languages. Strong proficiency in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets. Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, automation platforms, and system integrations. Experience with CRM platforms, with Salesforce strongly preferred. Familiarity with email marketing, registration, event management, or constituent management systems. Ability to create reports, dashboards, and data visualizations. Effective and responsible use of AI tools, with an openness to emerging technologies. Professional & Interpersonal Skills Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting abilities, with excellent attention to detail. Proactive, solutions-oriented approach to identifying and resolving technical issues. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and assignments. Ability to document technical processes clearly and consistently. Capacity to explain technical information to non-technical audiences. Strong relationship-building and collaboration skills across departments, cultures, and time zones. Discretion and sound judgment when handling confidential information. Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. Curious, adaptable, teachable, and willing to learn new technologies and approaches. Spiritual Alignment Committed follower of Jesus Christ. Affirmation of the Lausanne Covenant. Demonstrates Christian character, integrity, humility, and a servant-hearted approach to work and collaboration. Ability to engage respectfully and sensitively with people from diverse Christian theological, denominational, cultural, and geographical backgrounds within the global Christian community. Alignment with the mission, vision, and values of the organization. Benefits Fully remote, full-time position, open to candidates worldwide with a reliable internet connection. Flexibility to work from anywhere while collaborating effectively across multiple time zones. Opportunity to contribute to a global mission through data, technology, and digital transformation. Exposure to international projects and collaboration with globally distributed staff, contractors, partners, and volunteers. Opportunity to work with modern data systems, CRM platforms, integrations, automation, and emerging AI technologies. human_review.title: Professional, Product Support
human_review.description: Accountabilities:: Provide production support for PeopleSoft Financial Management 9.2, investigating and resolving complex issues across financial modules and associated third-party applications. Monitor system performance, data integrity, user experience, and scheduled batch processes to identify potential problems and prevent operational disruptions. Manage incidents according to business priorities and service-level agreements, performing root cause analysis and implementing permanent solutions to prevent recurring issues. Review, test, and implement system configuration changes, including security settings, application updates, and onboarding of new business entities. Support critical financial activities, particularly month-end and quarter-end closing processes, ensuring system availability and timely resolution of business-impacting issues. Collaborate with finance and accounting stakeholders to gather requirements, conduct gap analyses, assess business and technical impacts, and translate needs into functional specifications. Contribute to system enhancements, new module implementations, integrations, and functionality rollouts across multiple business units and geographical regions. Design and execute user acceptance testing, regression testing, test scenarios, and data validation activities to ensure the quality and reliability of system changes. Use SQL, PSQuery, and other analytical tools to investigate data discrepancies, troubleshoot technical issues, and support system performance assessments. Develop and maintain functional specifications, technical documentation, process guides, and end-user training materials. Provide expert guidance to business users, support knowledge transfer, and mentor junior team members and colleagues across IT functions. Collaborate with Oracle support teams and third-party vendors to resolve technical issues and evaluate new functionalities. Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, process optimization, predictive monitoring, and emerging technologies, including generative AI. Support escalated critical incidents, working closely with Level 2 and higher technical support teams to ensure timely resolution. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related discipline. 3–5 years of experience supporting PeopleSoft Financial Management 9.2 within an enterprise IT environment. Strong functional knowledge of PeopleSoft Financial and Supply Chain Management (FSCM) 9.2 modules and production support methodologies. Hands-on experience with system monitoring, incident management, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis. Proficiency in SQL and PSQuery for data investigation, system analysis, and rapid issue resolution. Good understanding of financial processes, particularly month-end closing, financial reporting, and enterprise accounting operations. Experience supporting system configurations, integrations, enhancements, and third-party financial applications. Knowledge of user acceptance testing, regression testing, data validation, and software quality assurance practices. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with excellent attention to detail and a proactive approach to identifying operational risks. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and remain effective under pressure during critical business periods. Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate across global and cross-functional teams. Preferred qualifications: PeopleSoft Financial Management certifications. Experience with process automation tools and emerging technologies, particularly generative AI applications for IT support. Familiarity with predictive analytics, proactive monitoring, and system optimization solutions. Previous experience mentoring technical teams or leading cross-functional initiatives. Exposure to enterprise financial systems and related business processes. Benefits: Remote working opportunity based in Bengaluru, India. Full-time position with a standard 40-hour working week. Opportunity to work with large-scale enterprise financial systems supporting global operations. Exposure to advanced technologies, automation, predictive analytics, and AI-driven IT support solutions. Opportunities to develop technical expertise in PeopleSoft Financial Management and enterprise application support. Professional growth through collaboration with international teams and experienced technology specialists. Opportunities to contribute to process improvements, system enhancements, and strategic technology initiatives. How Jobgether works: We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. #LI-CL1

verification_backlog.title: Customer Success Operations Specialist
verification_backlog.description: Description Company Profile: MAX is a global risk management organisation headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel, with its APAC headquarters in Mumbai. Led by veterans from Israeli Military Special Forces, Intelligence, Cyber, and Secret Services, we operate across 160 countries worldwide. With over 25 years of experience in intelligence, operations, and consulting, MAX supports Fortune 500 organizations with the intelligence and expertise to operate in complex and high-risk environments. Role Overview : Customer Success Operations Specialist The Customer Success Operations Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring customer satisfaction, adoption, and ongoing account health. This position serves as the operational backbone of the Customer Success team by analyzing customer usage trends, managing support requests, maintaining account records, assisting with compliance processes, and supporting customer onboarding and user management activities. The ideal candidate is highly organized, customer-focused, data driven, and capable of managing multiple priorities while maintaining strong attention to detail Job Description: Customer Adoption & Usage Analysis Monitor and analyze client usage data to identify adoption trends, engagement levels, and potential risks. Generate insights and recommendations that help drive increased product adoption and customer value realization. Proactively flag low-utilization accounts and collaborate with Account Managers (AMs) to improve engagement. Prepare regular reports and dashboards to track customer success metrics. Client Support Management Respond to and resolve customer support tickets in a timely and professional manner. Coordinate with internal teams to escalate and track complex issues through resolution. Ensure customer inquiries are accurately documented and followed through to completion. Maintain high customer satisfaction standards throughout every interaction. Customer Health Monitoring Maintain and update customer health dashboards and account records. Partner closely with Account Managers and customer points of contact (POCs) to keep account information current and accurate. Monitor account status, risks, milestones, and engagement indicators. Assist in identifying churn risks and opportunities for growth. User & Account Administration Create and manage user accounts according to customer requests and internal processes. Set up product demonstrations and trial environments for prospective and existing customers. Support onboarding activities for new customer users. Ensure customer user access and permissions are maintained accurately. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Support teams to ensure a seamless customer experience. Contribute to process improvements and operational efficiencies within the Customer Success organization. Assist in documenting customer success workflows, procedures, and best practices Job Details: 2+ years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Operations, SaaS Operations, Support, or a related role. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret customer usage data and identify actionable insights. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Experience using CRM, customer success, ticketing, and reporting platforms. Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Customer-focused mindset with strong problem-solving abilities. Originally posted on Himalayas

verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities: Strategic Planning & Execution Coordinate and manage the company's goal-setting processes, monitoring progress against key objectives and identifying potential deviations. Support leadership in defining, implementing, and tracking Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) to ensure alignment across departments. Conduct market, business, and operational research to develop actionable insights and recommendations that support strategic decision-making. Analyze organizational performance and help identify opportunities to improve execution and achieve business objectives. Decision-Making & Leadership Alignment Ensure employees have timely access to relevant business information, promoting transparency, alignment, and informed decision-making. Conduct analyses and experiments to evaluate business opportunities, identify trends, and recommend improvements. Prepare strategic content, presentations, and performance updates for company-wide meetings, leadership discussions, and team offsites. Support communication and alignment between senior leadership and cross-functional teams. Process Improvement & Operational Excellence Collaborate with department leaders to implement and continuously improve company-wide operating processes and frameworks. Develop efficient systems for knowledge sharing, documentation, and collaboration across a distributed workforce. Manage and continuously improve Notion as the organization's central knowledge management platform and Single Source of Truth. Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend practical solutions to streamline workflows and improve productivity. Support high-priority business initiatives and contribute wherever additional operational or strategic support is needed. Explore and promote the use of AI tools and emerging technologies to improve internal processes and overall business efficiency. Requirements: 3–6 years of relevant professional experience in management consulting, technology investment banking, venture capital, startup operations, or a combination of these fields. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with demonstrated experience using data and research to inform business decisions. Good understanding of SaaS business models and key financial and operational metrics, including revenue, margins, operating costs, and cash burn. Ability to interpret financial reports, assess business performance, and develop informed perspectives on organizational health. Excellent organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive approach to managing multiple priorities and delivering high-quality work. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly and interact effectively with senior stakeholders. Proven stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across different functions and influence outcomes without direct authority. Adaptability and a willingness to work in a fast-paced startup environment where priorities evolve and ambiguity is part of everyday operations. A continuous improvement mindset, combined with initiative, curiosity, and a practical approach to problem-solving. Genuine interest in AI tools and their potential to improve business operations, with a willingness to experiment, share insights, and contribute to broader AI adoption. Proficiency with macOS and confidence working remotely with collaboration and productivity tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, and Zoom. Strong written English skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across different time zones and geographical locations. Benefits: Competitive salary: The advertised annual salary range is $92,000–$125,000 for US-based candidates, depending on geographical location, experience, and expertise. Compensation for Poland-based candidates will be determined according to regional benchmarks and discussed during the recruitment process. Remote-first flexibility: Join a fully distributed organization with the flexibility to work remotely from an approved location. International collaboration: Work alongside talented professionals across different departments, countries, and time zones. Professional development: Gain valuable exposure to strategic planning, executive decision-making, financial analysis, and business operations within a rapidly growing technology company. High-impact responsibilities: Contribute directly to important business initiatives and help shape the company's operational strategy and growth. Technology-driven environment: Work with modern collaboration tools and explore innovative applications of AI to improve productivity and business processes. Career growth: Develop a broad understanding of SaaS business operations while building experience across multiple business functions. Inclusive workplace: Join a collaborative environment that values diversity, different perspectives, authenticity, and equal opportunities. Supportive team culture: Work with colleagues who value initiative, continuous learning, transparency, and shared success. Additional information: Employment is subject to geographical eligibility and local regulatory and security requirements. Resolve operational issues: Assess product and service-related challenges, investigate their causes, and resolve basic-to-intermediate problems independently while handling more complex cases with appropriate expertise. Maintain operational records: Document customer interactions, accurately categorize and tag issues, and ensure that relevant information is recorded for tracking and future reference. Support continuous operations: Learn and apply new processes across different operational areas, helping maintain smooth workflows and consistent service delivery. Collaborate with industry partners: Work closely with customers, internal teams, carriers, and other telecommunications stakeholders to troubleshoot issues, build trust, and improve operational outcomes. Requirements: Professional experience: 4–6 years of experience in customer-facing operations or support roles, preferably within e-commerce, telecommunications, or other global service environments. Technical knowledge: Basic technical proficiency, including SQL fundamentals, an understanding of APIs, and familiarity with data analytics. Data and reporting tools: Experience using SQL, Looker, Tableau, or similar data extraction, analysis, and visualization tools is an advantage. API understanding: Familiarity with APIs and related technologies, with the ability to use technical information to investigate and resolve operational issues. Customer orientation: A strong customer-first mindset, with empathy and a genuine interest in helping customers and carrier partners solve problems using data-driven insights. Telecommunications knowledge: Previous experience or familiarity with telecommunications services, phone number management, or carrier operations is desirable. Communication skills: Excellent written and verbal communication abilities, with the capacity to explain technical concepts and operational updates clearly, concisely, and professionally. Analytical and problem-solving skills: Strong troubleshooting abilities and attention to detail, with the confidence to investigate unfamiliar issues and navigate ambiguity. Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with internal teams, external customers, communications partners, and industry stakeholders to resolve issues and maintain strong working relationships. Organization and time management: Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize competing requests, manage workloads, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Schedule flexibility: Willingness to work flexible rotational schedules to support global operations and customer needs. Adaptability: A proactive, resourceful mindset, with the ability to take initiative, learn new processes, and remain effective under pressure. Benefits: Competitive compensation: Attractive pay package aligned with the role, experience, and location. Remote-first flexibility: Fully remote working arrangement within eligible locations in India. Healthcare coverage: Access to healthcare benefits, with offerings adapted to the employee's location. Generous time off: Paid time off to support rest, personal commitments, and work-life balance. Parental leave: Dedicated parental leave benefits to support employees and their families. Wellness support: Additional wellness leave and programs designed to promote employee well-being. Retirement savings: Access to a retirement savings program, subject to local eligibility and provisions. Global exposure: Opportunities to collaborate with international teams, customers, and telecommunications partners. Professional growth: The chance to develop technical, analytical, and operational expertise within a global communications technology environment. Inclusive culture: A diverse and supportive workplace that values different perspectives, encourages innovation, and gives employees opportunities to contribute ideas. Community involvement: Support for employee volunteering and charitable donation initiatives. Occasional travel: Opportunities to participate in in-person team gatherings, project meetings, and customer engagements when required. verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities: The Order Processing Virtual Assistant will support daily order management activities, ensuring accurate data entry, timely processing, and reliable administrative coordination. Key responsibilities include: Monitor designated email inboxes for incoming purchase orders and ensure timely processing. Enter purchase order information into the designated platform, verifying customer details, product descriptions, quantities, and pricing. Ensure all orders are processed accurately and within agreed timelines. Maintain accurate digital records of processed orders and update order statuses within company systems. Identify and report discrepancies, missing information, and other order-related issues. Follow established procedures for managing order exceptions and resolving administrative inconsistencies. Provide general administrative support related to order processing and daily business operations. Communicate with internal team members regarding order processing questions, discrepancies, and operational concerns. Maintain organized digital documentation and records. Contribute to process improvement initiatives and support greater efficiency in order management workflows. Required and preferred qualifications include: Previous experience in data entry, order processing, administrative support, or customer operations is preferred. Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate records. Ability to process high volumes of information efficiently and consistently. Excellent written English communication skills, with good comprehension and speaking abilities. Intermediate computer proficiency and the ability to learn new software platforms quickly. Reliable internet connection and availability to work within scheduled coverage windows. Familiarity with e-commerce platforms, ERP systems, or order management software is an advantage. Knowledge of SAP Commerce Cloud is preferred, although experience with similar e-commerce or order management platforms is acceptable. Familiarity with email tools such as Outlook or Gmail. verification_backlog.title: MARKETING OPERATIONS COORDINATOR
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities: Maintain accurate marketing action lists, task owners, deadlines, and dependencies using Asana and shared trackers. Convert meeting decisions and approved campaign plans into clear action points, ensuring consistent follow-up and accountability. Maintain marketing calendars and campaign milestones, proactively following up on overdue tasks and missing information. Schedule and publish approved social media content, checking captions, links, creative assets, and publishing times for accuracy. Support routine social media engagement and approved communications, escalating sensitive or complex interactions when needed. Coordinate approved PR and influencer outreach, maintaining accurate contact records, responses, and follow-up schedules. Organize gifting and sample logistics, including product requests, shipping, returns, and creator deliverables. Coordinate routine agreements, permissions, and supporting documentation through established approval processes. Track PR coverage, influencer content, and outstanding commitments through to completion. Handle administrative and logistical coordination for approved marketing activities and campaigns. Organize campaign assets, documents, and shared records to ensure information remains accessible and up to date. Compile reporting inputs, identify missing evidence or information, and help maintain reliable records of completed work. Identify and escalate blockers, unclear responsibilities, overdue actions, and decisions requiring management input. Provide ongoing support for recurring marketing administration and coordination as required. Requirements: Strong organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills, with excellent attention to detail. Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple workflows, stakeholders, and deadlines independently. Confidence following up professionally with different stakeholders and ensuring actions are completed without constant supervision. A proactive approach to identifying missing information, anticipating delays, and escalating issues appropriately. Excellent written English and professional communication skills. Comfortable using task-management platforms, spreadsheets, shared trackers, and digital collaboration tools. Practical experience in marketing operations, social media publishing, PR, influencer coordination, gifting, or similar administrative and coordination activities. Ability to work reliably and independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with a UK-based team. Familiarity with Asana or similar project-management tools is an advantage. Experience in fashion, ecommerce, retail, or consumer brands is beneficial but not essential. Benefits: Work arrangement: Full-time remote position based in India. Working hours: Must be able to work substantially within UK business hours. Opportunity to support a broad range of marketing activities and collaborate closely with a marketing team. Hands-on exposure to campaign coordination, social publishing, PR, influencer relations, and marketing operations. verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities:: Conduct basic data research and financial analyses to support business operations and provide findings and recommendations to managers and project leads. Prepare business, financial, and data analyses in collaboration with inventory management, information systems, financial auditing, and other internal departments. Review business dashboards and identify unusual performance patterns, emerging trends, and potential areas for improvement. Analyze market strategies, related products, market trends, and market share information to support business planning. Organize, plan, and recommend routine analytical activities and reports in accordance with established processes and procedures. Develop, create, and implement standardized reports to support recurring business reporting requirements. Monitor the accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of data used in business analyses and reports, escalating inconsistencies to the appropriate teams. Collect and consolidate business intelligence from industry reports, publicly available information, field reports, and external data sources. Follow up on analytical findings and reporting recommendations to ensure that results are reviewed and appropriate actions are implemented. Support departmental activities by completing specific operational and analytical assignments. Participate in due diligence and transition-related activities when required. Maintain and update business intelligence tools, databases, dashboards, systems, and reporting methodologies to ensure reliable and efficient analysis. Understanding of fundamental financial, accounting, and business problem-solving principles. Ability to apply standard financial and analytical techniques to business problems involving multiple variables. Experience calculating financial figures and amounts, including discounts, interest, commissions, ratios, percentages, and sales volumes. Previous experience in a business analyst or sales analysis role is an advantage. Experience in financial analysis, business operations, and data reporting is highly desirable. Familiarity with SAP is an advantage. Knowledge of FoxPro and Visual Basic is considered a plus. Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to interpret data and identify meaningful business trends. Good organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly when managing financial information and reporting accuracy. Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly and collaborate effectively with different departments. Proactive and structured approach to handling assignments, following up on recommendations, and meeting deadlines. Ability to work under direct supervision while demonstrating initiative and growing autonomy in day-to-day responsibilities. Benefits: Full-time employment opportunity. Opportunities for professional development, continuous learning, and career advancement. Exposure to international business operations, financial analysis, and business intelligence projects. Opportunity to collaborate with experienced professionals across finance, technology, and business support functions. Collaborative and empowering workplace culture that encourages employees to share ideas, take initiative, and contribute to meaningful business improvements.
